## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `0cf500af90e8c6b4288ef5d36bd62275266a93db`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json, scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh, scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs, scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs, scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md, scripts/pm/check-label-desc-cap.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/label-write.mjs, scripts/pm/sweep-closed-cards.mjs, scripts/pm/fleet-write/validate.mjs, .github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml, .github/workflows/stale.yml
Reviewed-at: 2026-11-05T12:02Z · PR #30445 · card #29745 · ruling of record: card comment 6594600712 (letter A, items 1–4, 「No new gate」, `pm:awaiting-maintainer` kept distinct)

Inputs: the card body and all three comments, the PR body, its 13-file list, the net diff against `main` at the head, the head's check-runs (31 success, 20 skipped, 0 failed, 0 in progress at the time of this record — `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Test UI`, `Live half-state sweep` all `success`; `Build Core`, `Lint UI`, `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI` skipped as expected for a diff with no package path). `origin/main` and the head tree were read with `git grep` / `gh api` only; nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **New vocabulary label `pm:awaiting-merge`** (`ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the six-repo loop, colour `e07b63`, description 98 code points; `needs-user-decision`'s description rewritten to 「decision cards only, never on a PR」, 86 code points) — RIGHT. Ruling item 1 verbatim; `check-label-desc-cap.mjs` measures Unicode code points (CJK and ② included) against the 100 cap, both fit, and the gate is green on the head (`Lint · repo & tooling gates`).
2. **The PR half of the maintainer's inbox moves to `pm:awaiting-merge`** — SKILL.md 复核 ②, and the three copies of the 终局四件套 sentence in `dispatch-gates.mjs` (`changedLineLines`), `check-governed-merges.mjs` (`renderSizeLines` + header) and `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (`renderSizeVerdict` + header) — RIGHT. Ruling item 2; the over-3000-line terminal shares that sentence, so it moves with it, and none of those three reads the label (prose only, checked on `origin/main`).
3. **`needs-user-decision` narrowed to issues only** (SKILL.md state-table row, `state-machine.md` L7 「皆 issue 态」, `triage-duties.md` L43 「只挂 issue」) — RIGHT. The six-state mutex is untouched: SKILL.md L123, `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS`, `PM_STATE_LABELS`, `PM_RESIDUE_LABELS`, `SEEN_LABEL_PAGES`, `GRADING_STATE_LABELS`, `INDEFINITE_TARGET_LABELS`, `H71_NOT_CANDIDATE_LABELS` are byte-identical and `pm:awaiting-merge` is in none of them (pinned by the new H48 case). The only prefix reader of `pm:` in `scripts/**` (`h18RetriageAged`, `l.startsWith('pm:')`) runs on `pm:retriage` ISSUES, so a `pm:`-prefixed PR label reaches no state reader; `sweep-closed-cards.mjs` skips PR rows and reads the explicit `PM_RESIDUE_LABELS`; `label-write.mjs`'s one-of refusal reads the imported six.
4. **Module surface of `check-half-states.mjs`**: `GOVERNED_PR_DECISION_LABEL` removed; `GOVERNED_PR_AWAITING_MERGE_LABEL` and `DECISION_INBOX_LABEL` added — RIGHT. Importers on `origin/main`: `check-handover.mjs` alone (updated in this diff); `fleet-roster.mjs` is the one new importer and rides the edge it already had (`SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE`), so no new module edge. `git grep` for the old name outside those two files: zero hits on `main`, zero on the head.
5. **H48's accept set**: an open governed PR on Tier H (drafts in; Tier S excluded by `governedLandsOnRecord`; merged/closed out) carrying an `**ACCEPT**` verdict must carry `pm:awaiting-merge`; the old shape no longer satisfies the label half (pinned) — RIGHT, and report-only: H48 is band `state`, `isLoudFinding` fires on the P0 marker alone, and `half-state-patrol.yml`'s job never fails on findings. A Tier S PR (this one included) is outside H48, which is exactly the label's meaning — the seat lands Tier S itself, nothing waits on the maintainer's click.
6. **`check-handover.mjs` `acceptedPullWait`**: the new label on the stay-behind pull is a wait; the old shape falls through to the timeline reading like an unlabelled pull (pinned) — RIGHT. Transition consequence: an in-flight card whose ACCEPTed Tier H pull still carries only `needs-user-decision` reads `not-waiting` ⇒ `[claim-unreleased]` at a handover until the one label write; that write is the landing step already named (item 4), see ④.
7. **`fleet-roster.mjs`**: the `awaiting merge` column (pulls carrying the label that close an in-flight card of the seat; mailbox pulls excluded; no new read — labels ride the open-pulls listing), `inboxTotals` (decision cards = open `needs-user-decision` ISSUES, a labelled PR row counts nowhere; awaiting-merge = open pulls carrying the label, every repo in), the 「决策卡 N · 待您审合 PR M」 line never summed, `--json.inboxes` — RIGHT. Ruling item 3 for the roster; the fixture pins one old-shape PR row (25401) counting nowhere and one new-shape pull (25427) in its own column; the import-line pin also forbids a second spelling of the label in that file.
8. **④ dependents index, H52, H62, H73** read `DECISION_INBOX_LABEL` — same value, same populations (H62/H73 exclude PR rows; `decisionDependentIndex` runs over the unscoped open listing as before) — RIGHT, no behavioural change.
9. **Reader sweep** (`origin/main` and the head: `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`): no workflow names `needs-user-decision`; `stale.yml` exempts neither label (`exempt-pr-labels: pinned,security,work-in-progress`), so the swap changes nothing there; `fleet-roster`'s `awaiting ruling` already excluded pulls; `board-snapshot.mjs`, `check-owed-reviews.mjs`, `check-prior-rulings.mjs`, `close-cards.mjs`, `post-stamped.mjs` read the label on cards or comments only; `mailbox-open.mjs`'s `PR_LABELS` untouched; the relay (`fleet-write/validate.mjs`) types `labels` as a list with no vocabulary, so the seat can write the new label today. No PR-side reader the diff missed. One stale PROSE string found in the cited code, not a reader: H54's row text (`check-half-states.mjs` L12896, and the comment at L12795) still prints 「`needs-user-decision` on cards and PRs」 — should-fix S2 below.
10. **Ruling item 4** — PR #29698 merged before dispatch (moot as the PM read); the live old-shape PR is objectstack#30263; its relabel and the label-object creation (`bash scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh --reconcile` on the loop's repos) are label writes owed by the landing seat, not diff — RIGHT.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: 13 files under `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**`, no released package moved, no authorable key, no published export. PR body carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` as line-initial declarations; there is no changeset to mirror them. `Check Changeset` is `success` on the head. Clause-②: no.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions: []` — nothing to answer there. The eight deviations and three out-of-scope notes of the `os-dev-report` (card comment 6657206466), each answered:

- **No changeset** — accepted (②).
- **The GitHub label object was not created** — accepted: no relay op creates labels. Landing order matters and the body states it: `--reconcile` FIRST (it both creates `pm:awaiting-merge` and rewrites `needs-user-decision`'s live description — the create-only default keeps the old text, read in the shim at `ensure-pm-labels.sh` L110–161), then the relabel of #30263.
- **Ruling item 4 moot for #29698; #30263 left to the landing seat** — accepted: a label write by the seat that lands this PR, in the same landing; the three PRs in `duly` / `www.objectos.ai` sit outside the label loop — a seat decision, noted on the card, not filed.
- **SKILL.md 六态互斥 line left byte-identical** — accepted: issues-only is stated in the state-table row, 复核 ②'s next clause and `state-machine.md` L7; the mutex sentence names the six states and needs no change.
- **Two reference lines deleted to pay the ratchet** — judged in ④: both rules survive.
- **`check:doc-formula-expressions` exit 3 then rerun after a build** — a process note; the reading of record is the head's `Lint & Repo Gates` success.
- **Foreground `tail --pid` wait crossed the cap** — process hygiene, no bearing on the tree.
- **Commit trailers** — the model-free pair AGENTS.md requires; conforms.
- **Out of scope: relabel list / reconcile** — carrier: the landing seat; accepted as above.
- **Boundary: `pm:awaiting-merge` on an ISSUE is unpatrolled** — accepted under the ruling's 「No new gate」: the rule lives in SKILL.md L107/L194, `state-machine.md` L7 and the label description; a report-only row is a later card only if that shape is ever measured on the board. Not escalated.
- Author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay — no login note owed.

### ④ Design judgment

Judged against ruling comment 6594600712 (option A, items 1–4, 「No new gate」, `pm:awaiting-maintainer` kept distinct) and the enforcing scripts read in the head tree.

- **SKILL.md** (L20 three entry points; L107 row; L189 复核 ②; L194) — HOLDS. H48 reads exactly the label ② writes, on exactly the population ② covers (Tier H, awaiting a human approval; Tier S never carries it, `governedLandsOnRecord`); `acceptedPullWait` reads the same constant; L123 and the `pm:awaiting-maintainer` row are untouched and the two labels stay distinct (issue vs PR, outside-GitHub act vs in-GitHub click). Tried to break it: L194 「不入六态」 against the `pm:` prefix — the only prefix reader is H18 on `pm:retriage` issues; the relay's typed `labels` list lets the seat write it now; 席位落地's 「清标」 (L196) removes it, so no closed-pull residue question arises and `sweep-closed-cards` skips PRs regardless. Ratchet: 319/319; edited prose lines 104–115 bytes; L107 is a table row (structural exemption class `table`).
- **references/lanes/director.md** (L53–54) — HOLDS: ruling item 3 for 呈批 and 摘要, counted apart. Deleted L25: clause 「本席任何形态都纯召唤制,⛔ 无任何 routine」 survives at L7 「授权面 = 人工召唤,任一项目可召 … 直连 ⛔ 无 Routine/cron」; clause 「分诊席默认同项目召唤」 survives at `lanes/triage.md` L4 「由维护者一句召唤到任一项目,默认同总监席项目」; the pointer clause 「职责见 `triage.md`」 is not load-bearing — `lanes/triage.md` stays reachable from `triage-duties.md` L100, `project-forms.md` L15, `lanes/security.md` L49 and `security-findings.md` L50, and no script pins the deleted sentence. 86/86; 112/117 bytes.
- **references/seat-lifecycle.md** (L74–75) — HOLDS: the health metric splits 「决策卡 N·待您审合 PR M」, 「两数 ⛔ 不合计」, and the open-downstream-dependents clause is kept; it matches `fleet-roster`'s inbox line and the ④ dependents count H14's index feeds. 98/98; 116/108 bytes.
- **references/state-machine.md** (L7 「皆 issue 态」) — HOLDS: states what H29/H30's population and `PM_EXCLUSIVE_STATE_LABELS` already enforce. 41/41; 113 bytes.
- **references/triage-duties.md** (L11 round records split; L43 只挂 issue) — HOLDS: 「后者 = open `pm:awaiting-merge` PR」 is the same filter `inboxTotals` counts. Deleted L12 「Backlog sweep 是常设职责,每 fire 扫任一析取命中的卡」 survives at L19 「首触定级与五析取 sweep 每 fire 跑到清空,先于旧卡重验」; the only other mention of "Backlog sweep" is a comment in `check-half-states.mjs` (L3788) pointing at SKILL.md, not a pin. 100/100; 113/114 bytes.
- **The transition** (the question of record): once this lands, H48 reports #30263 as 「no `pm:awaiting-merge` label」 — one report-only row, cleared by the landing seat's one label write, and `check-handover` carries the same single consequence. That is the ruled outcome (item 4 makes the relabel part of the landing), not noise; nothing patrols the retired shape beyond that, which is right under 「No new gate」.
- **No new gate**: nothing new reds. H48, `acceptedPullWait` and the roster are existing instruments reading a renamed label; the queue guard, the landing pre-check and the post-merge audit read no label.

**Must-fix: none.** **Should-fix** (either a delta commit on this PR or a follow-up; neither blocks landing):

- **S1** `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` L178 keeps its own `export const DECISION_INBOX_LABEL = 'needs-user-decision'` while `check-half-states.mjs` now exports the same name and value — two declarations of one constant across the pair this PR explicitly binds; import it from `check-half-states.mjs` beside `GOVERNED_PR_AWAITING_MERGE_LABEL` so the single-spelling rule holds across files, not only inside each.
- **S2** `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` H54 row text (L12896) and its comment (L12795) still say 「`needs-user-decision` on cards and PRs」 — rendered into the patrol anchor; stale under this PR. Drop "and PRs" in both.
